sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.number,sp.name as bill_to,sp.contact_name as attention,s.protocol,s.title as study,i.issued_on,i.due_on,round(i.amount_cents/100.0,2) as total,s.currency from invoices i join studies s on s.id=i.study_id join sponsors sp on sp.id=s.sponsor_id where i.id=$1

sections.title: Lines
sections.note: Each line is a completed visit, screen failure or fee under the clinical trial agreement.
sections.sql: select c.earned_on,c.description,c.kind,round(c.amount_cents/100.0,2) as amount from charges c where c.invoice_id=$1 order by c.earned_on

name: visit-schedule
title: Your study visit schedule
for_each: select p.id,p.subject_number from participants p where p.status in ('enrolled','screening')

sections.title: Study
sections.sql: select s.protocol,s.title,p.subject_number,c.name as your_coordinator from participants p join studies s on s.id=p.study_id left join staff c on c.id=p.coordinator_id where p.id=$1

sections.title: Visits
sections.note: Each visit can happen any day inside its window. Call us if a date does not suit.
sections.sql: select visit,window_opens,window_closes,case when state in ('done','out of window') then 'done '||completed_on else '' end as status from v_visits where participant_id=$1 order by seq

name: delegation-log
title: Site delegation log
for_each: select id,protocol from studies where status<>'closed'

sections.title: Study
sections.sql: select s.protocol,s.title,pi.name as principal_investigator,s.ethics_ref from studies s left join staff pi on pi.id=s.pi_id where s.id=$1

sections.title: Delegated tasks
sections.note: The principal investigator signs and dates each line. Check against the signed paper or electronic log before an inspection.
sections.sql: select st.name,st.role,d.tasks,d.start_on,d.end_on,d.pi_signed_on,st.gcp_trained_on,st.cv_signed_on from delegations d join staff st on st.id=d.staff_id where d.study_id=$1 order by d.start_on,st.name

name: progress-report
title: Annual progress report figures (draft)
for_each: select id,protocol from studies where status not in ('feasibility','closed') and ethics_approved_on is not null

sections.title: Study
sections.note: Draft figures for the ethics committee's own form. Nothing is submitted from here.
sections.sql: select s.protocol,s.title,s.ethics_ref,s.ethics_approved_on,s.last_progress_report_on,s.status,s.consent_version from studies s where s.id=$1

sections.title: Recruitment
sections.sql: select target,enrolled,screening,screen_failed from v_enrolment where study_id=$1

sections.title: Safety
sections.sql: select count(*)::int as adverse_events,count(*) filter (where serious)::int as serious from adverse_events a join participants p on p.id=a.participant_id where p.study_id=$1

sections.title: Deviations
sections.sql: select occurred_on,description,reported_on from deviations where study_id=$1 order by occurred_on

name: sae-summary
title: Serious adverse event summary (site record)
for_each: select a.id,p.subject_number||'-'||to_char(a.aware_at,'YYYYMMDD') as ref from adverse_events a join participants p on p.id=a.participant_id where a.serious

sections.title: Event
sections.note: A site record of what was reported and when. The sponsor's own SAE form is what goes to the sponsor.
sections.sql: select s.protocol,p.subject_number,a.description,a.onset_on,to_char(a.aware_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as site_aware,to_char(a.reported_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as reported_to_sponsor,round(extract(epoch from (a.reported_at-a.aware_at))/3600)::int as hours,a.outcome,a.resolved_on from adverse_events a join participants p on p.id=a.participant_id join studies s on s.id=p.study_id where a.id=$1
